name: Fondation Vasarely
elevationDatum: Rigid local exterior foundation plane y=0; metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Mapped rotation baked once. No sea-level, DEM or Mercator scaling.
note: Sixteen-cell honeycomb museum with an open hexagonal courtyard, fourteen faceted pyramidal skylights, low glazed base and alternating black/cream circles within square façade panels; original geometry, no artwork textures or signage. The foundation describes 11 m interior volumes while restoration research describes 9 m external alvéoles; this model uses 9 m façades and an estimated 2.4 m skylight rise, not an asserted survey. OSM mapped lattice is approximately 5% larger than the published 14 m cell width, so the mapped exterior is retained and the disagreement is recorded. The distant 2011 photograph is a secondary confirmation of the same unchanged circle-panel layout seen in the more recent front photograph; restoration did not change this massing. Dossier painting, unrelated Gordes sculpture, concert and construction-stage images were rejected. No reflecting pool, plaza or terrain is modelled; y=0 is the rigid exterior wall foundation plane. Cityscape: not tested. Full 3D world: not tested.
